16048.title: UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge — V2X-Real Track — ECCV Workshop 2026
16048.description: Synthesize LiDAR data targeting V2X-Real's infrastructure-centric distribution; train on synthetic, evaluate on real V2X-Real-IC.
16048.description_zh: 合成LiDAR数据，针对V2X-Real的基础设施中心分布；在合成数据上训练，在真实V2X-Real-IC上评估。

pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge — V2X-Real Track

Muhammad Shahbaz  ·  Shaurya Agarwal

A challenge track of the 6th DriveX Workshop @ ECCV 2026 — drivex-workshop.github.io/eccv2026.

Roadside LiDAR perception for intelligent transportation systems is bottlenecked by the cost and rarity of large, well-annotated real datasets. This challenge asks: can synthetic LiDAR data be made realistic enough that a deep learning model trained on it generalizes to real LiDAR frames?

Towards that, this challenge asks participants to generate their own synthetic LiDAR data targeting the V2X-Real distribution, train an object detector on that data, and submit detections on real held-out frames. We score on (1) how distributionally close their synthetic frames are to real ones, and (2) how well the sim-only detector performs on real frames.

Reference resources for participants

To support participants who would like a documented starting point, we make publicly available a complete reference pipeline covering synthesis methodology, empirical analysis, ready-to-use synthetic datasets, and an open-source LiDAR data processing and visualization software. These materials are offered as orientation, not as requirements.

The synthesis pipeline is described in UrbanTwin: Building High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Sim2Real LiDAR Perception and Evaluation (arXiv preprint), with a deeper empirical analysis including the distributional realism metrics adopted by this challenge in High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Bridging the Sim2Real Gap in LiDAR-Based ITS Perception (IEEE T-ITS, 2026).

The synthetic LiDAR datasets generated with that pipeline are released in UrbanTwin: Synthetic Roadside LiDAR Datasets (IEEE OJ-ITS, 2026) and are available for download at Harvard Dataverse. Each dataset contains 10K frames annotated across six object categories for detection, tracking, and segmentation tasks, and is directly compatible with the multi-class evaluation used here; empirical analysis in papers include both the distributional realism metrics and single-class 3D object detection study as proof-of-concept. For end-to-end LiDAR processing we also provide our LiGuard Framework (IEEE T-IV, 2026) with short, more software focused read on The Journal of Open Source Software.

What you will do

  1. Download the public real V2X-Real dataset and the released detection-test point clouds (50 real frames, no labels).
  2. Generate synthetic LiDAR frames using any approach you like — simulation (CARLA, LGSVL, custom), generative models (diffusion, GANs, flow-based), hybrid pipelines, or anything else.
  3. Train a 3D object detector (any architecture) on only your synthetic data.
  4. Submit:
    • 50 of your synthetic LiDAR frames,
    • your detector's predictions on the 50 released test point clouds,
    • and a signed honor declaration.

Scoring at a glance

Combined score = 0.6 × normalized 3D mAP + 0.4 × normalized realism, where 3D mAP is averaged across the 3 object categories defined for this track (vehicle, pedestrian, truck) and realism averages normalized Chamfer Distance, MMD, EMD, and Fréchet Point-cloud Distance. See the Evaluation tab for the formulae.

Phases

(line 49). New block:

Prizes

Per track:

  • 1st place: USD 500
  • 2nd place: USD 300
  • 3rd place: USD 200

Sponsor(s) will be announced before the Development phase opens.

Phases

  • Development — public leaderboard, up to 5 submissions/day per participant, 100 total. Use this to iterate.
  • Final — private leaderboard until close, 5 total submissions per participant. The final-phase ranking determines the winners.

Baselines

Reference numbers are listed in the Data tab.
pages.content_zh: # UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR挑战赛 — V2X-Real赛道 *6th DriveX Workshop @ ECCV 2026的挑战赛道 — drivex-workshop.github.io/eccv2026。* 路侧LiDAR感知在智能交通系统中的发展受到了大规模、高质量标注真实数据成本高昂且稀缺的限制。本挑战赛提出问题：合成LiDAR数据是否能够足够逼真，使得在其上训练的深度学习模型能够泛化到真实LiDAR帧？ 为此，本挑战赛要求参赛者生成自己的合成LiDAR数据以匹配**V2X-Real**分布，在该数据上训练目标检测器，并提交对真实保留测试集帧的检测结果。评分基于：(1)其合成帧与真实帧的分布接近程度，以及(2)仅在合成数据上训练的检测器在真实帧上的性能。 ## 参赛者参考资源 为支持需要有据可查的起点的参赛者，我们公开提供了一整套完整参考管道，涵盖合成方法论、实证分析、即用型合成数据集，以及开源LiDAR数据处理和可视化软件。这些资料作为参考方向提供，不作为强制要求。 合成管道详见UrbanTwin: Building High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Sim2Real LiDAR Perception and Evaluation（arXiv预印本），更深入的实证分析包括本挑战赛采用的分布真实性指标详见High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Bridging the Sim2Real Gap in LiDAR-Based ITS Perception（IEEE T-ITS，2026）。 使用该管道生成的合成LiDAR数据集发布在UrbanTwin: Synthetic Roadside LiDAR Datasets（IEEE OJ-ITS，2026），可在Harvard Dataverse下载。每个数据集包含**10K帧**，标注涵盖**六个物体类别**，支持**检测、跟踪和分割任务**，与本挑战赛采用的多类别评估直接兼容；论文中的实证分析包括分布真实性指标和单类别3D物体检测概念验证研究。对于端到端LiDAR处理，我们还提供LiGuard框架（IEEE T-IV，2026），以及更简洁的软件相关阅读《开源软件期刊》。 ## 你将要做的事 1. 下载公开的真实**V2X-Real**数据集和已发布的检测测试点云（50个真实帧，无标签）。 2. 使用任何方法生成合成LiDAR帧——模拟（CARLA、LGSVL、自定义）、生成模型（扩散、GAN、基于流的模型）、混合管道或其他任何方法。 3. **仅在你的合成数据**上训练3D物体检测器（任何架构）。 4. 提交： - 50个你的合成LiDAR帧 - 你的检测器对50个已发布测试点云的预测结果 - 一份签署的诚信声明 ## 评分概览 综合得分 = `0.6 × 归一化3D mAP` + `0.4 × 归一化真实性`，其中3D mAP在本赛道定义的**3个**物体类别（*车辆、行人、卡车*）上求平均，真实性对归一化倒角距离、最大均值差异、地球移动距离和Fréchet点云距离求平均

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
Evaluation Protocol

Two scores are computed and combined into a single Combined score that determines leaderboard rank.

1. Distributional realism

Aggregation:

  1. Concatenate the 50 submitted synthetic frames into one set S_syn; concatenate the 50 held-out real reference frames into S_real.
  2. Mask both to the point-cloud range [-40, -40, -8, 40, 40, 2].
  3. Subsample uniformly at random to N = 10,000 points per side, with seed 1234 (identical seed used by the local evaluator in the starter kit).
  4. Compute one CD, MMD, EMD, and FPD across the entire 10,000-point sets.

1a. Chamfer Distance (CD)

CD(P, Q) = (1/|P|) Σ_{p ∈ P} min_{q ∈ Q} ||p - q||²
         + (1/|Q|) Σ_{q ∈ Q} min_{p ∈ P} ||p - q||²

Squared-L2 nearest-neighbor cost; symmetric. Lower is better.

1b. Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD)

MMD²(X, Y) = E[k(x, x')] + E[k(y, y')] - 2 E[k(x, y)],   k(a, b) = exp(-γ ||a - b||²)

Unbiased estimator (off-diagonal). Bandwidth γ is set by the median heuristic on a 1 000-point joint subsample (γ = 1 / (2 · median ||x - y||²)) so the kernel does not saturate at LiDAR spatial scales. Lower is better.

1c. Earth Mover's Distance (EMD)

EMD(X, Y) = √ ( min_{T ∈ Π(X, Y)} Σ_{i,j} T_{ij} · ||x_i - y_j|| )

Wasserstein-1 with Euclidean ground cost, solved exactly by the network simplex (POT's ot.emd2). Reported in metres. Lower is better.

1d. Fréchet Point-cloud Distance (FPD)

FPD = ||μ_X - μ_Y||² + Tr(Σ_X + Σ_Y - 2 (Σ_X · Σ_Y)^{1/2})

FID-style: fits a 3-variate Gaussian to each set's points, computes the 2-Wasserstein between Gaussians. Lower is better.

2. 3D Object Detection

Participants submit detections (predictions.json) on 50 real LiDAR frames whose ground truth is held out. We compute average precision over the 3 object categories defined for this track (vehicle, pedestrian, truck), at IoU thresholds 0.5 (primary) and 0.7 (secondary). Per-class AP is reported, and mean AP across classes (mAP) is the leaderboard's detection score; classes with zero ground-truth instances in the held-out set are excluded from the mean. Both KITTI 11-point and 40-point interpolated AP are reported; the 40-point form is the leaderboard primary.

Ground-truth and predicted boxes use the OpenPCDet 7-DoF format [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading]. IoU is computed as 3D intersection-over-union between two oriented BEV rectangles times the Z overlap. The KITTI truncation/occlusion/min-height difficulty filter is not applied because those depend on 2D bounding-box annotations that are not natural for roadside LiDAR datasets.

The valid class strings for this track are listed in config.json (shipped in reference_data/) and in submission_format.md in the starter kit. Any prediction with an unrecognized class label is discarded.

3. Combined score

Each component is min-max normalized into [0, 1] using a per-track normalization range:

score_realism   = mean( norm(CD), norm(MMD), norm(EMD), norm(FPD) )    (lower-is-better → 1 - clip)
score_detection = norm( AP_3d @ IoU 0.5 )                               (higher-is-better → clip)
score_combined  = 0.6 · score_detection + 0.4 · score_realism

Normalization endpoints are public in config.json (shipped in reference_data/), so the local evaluator and the server compute identical scores.

Reproducibility

  • Realism is dataset-level — frame ordering does not matter. Submit the 50 synthetic frames in any consistent naming.
  • Subsampling RNG seed: 1234 (same on server and starting kit).
  • The exact scoring program shipped to the Codabench worker is included in the starting kit.
pages.content_zh:
# 评估协议

计算两个分数并将其合并为单一的综合分数，该分数决定排行榜排名。

1. 分布真实性

聚合：

  1. 将50帧提交的合成帧连接成一个集合S_syn；将50帧保留的真实参考帧连接成S_real。
  2. 将两者掩码到点云范围[-40, -40, -8, 40, 40, 2]。
  3. 以均匀随机方式以每侧N = 10,000个点进行下采样，种子值为1234（与启动工具包中的本地评估器使用的种子相同）。
  4. 在整个10,000个点的集合上计算一个 CD、MMD、EMD和FPD。

1a. 倒角距离（CD）

CD(P, Q) = (1/|P|) Σ_{p ∈ P} min_{q ∈ Q} ||p - q||²
         + (1/|Q|) Σ_{q ∈ Q} min_{p ∈ P} ||p - q||²

平方L2最近邻成本；对称。越低越好。

1b. 最大平均差异（MMD）

MMD²(X, Y) = E[k(x, x')] + E[k(y, y')] - 2 E[k(x, y)],   k(a, b) = exp(-γ ||a - b||²)

无偏估计量（非对角线）。带宽γ由1,000个点的联合子样本上的中位数启发式设置（γ = 1 / (2 · median ||x - y||²)），使核在激光雷达空间尺度不会饱和。越低越好。

1c. 地球搬运距离（EMD）

EMD(X, Y) = √ ( min_{T ∈ Π(X, Y)} Σ_{i,j} T_{ij} · ||x_i - y_j|| )

Wasserstein-1距离，欧几里得地面成本，由网络单纯形精确求解（POT的ot.emd2）。以米为单位报告。越低越好。

1d. Fréchet点云距离（FPD）

FPD = ||μ_X - μ_Y||² + Tr(Σ_X + Σ_Y - 2 (Σ_X · Σ_Y)^{1/2})

FID风格：对每个集合的点拟合3变量高斯分布，计算高斯分布之间的2-Wasserstein距离。越低越好。

2. 三维物体检测

参赛者在50帧真实激光雷达帧上提交检测结果（predictions.json），这些帧的真实标签被保留。我们计算在本赛道定义的3个物体类别（车辆、行人、卡车）上的平均精度，IoU阈值为0.5（主要）和0.7（次要）。报告按类别的AP，类别间的平均AP（mAP）是排行榜的检测分数；保留集中真实标签数为零的类别被排除在平均值外。报告KITTI 11点和40点插值AP；40点形式是排行榜的主要指标。

真实标签和预测框使用OpenPCDet 7-DoF格式[x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading]。IoU计算为两个有向BEV矩形的三维交并比乘以Z重叠。未应用KITTI截断/遮挡/最小高度难度过滤，因为这些取决于对于路边激光雷达数据集不自然的二维边界框注释。

本赛道的有效类别字符串列在config.json中（在reference_data/中提供）和启动工具包中的submission_format.md中。任何具有无法识别的类别标签的预测都将被丢弃。

3. 综合分数

每个组件使用按赛道的归一化范围被最小-最大归一化到[0, 1]：

score_realism   = mean( norm(CD), norm(MMD), norm(EMD), norm(FPD) )    (越低越好 → 1 - clip)
score_detection = norm( AP_3d @ IoU 0.5 )                               (越高越好 → clip)
score_combined  = 0.6 · score_detection + 0.4 · score_realism

归一化端点在config.json中公开（在reference_data/中提供），因此本地评估器和服务器计算相同的分数。

pages.title: Data
pages.content:
Data

V2X-Real

Real V2X-Real data is publicly available from its original release. We do not redistribute it. Participants must obtain the real dataset directly from its source under its own license.

  • Source: https://github.com/ucla-mobility/V2X-Real
  • License: see the source.

Released for participants

The starting kit (Files tab → starting_kit) contains:

  • detection_test_frames/ — 50 real LiDAR frames (point clouds only, no labels) on which you must run your detector and submit predictions.
  • detection_test_frame_ids.json — the canonical list of frame IDs your predictions.json must cover, in order.
  • forbidden_frames.txt — 100 frame IDs you may not train, validate, or hyperparameter-tune on. This is the union of the 50 detection-test frames and the 50 realism-reference frames. Honor system, enforced by signed declaration in your submission.
  • local_eval.py — the exact scoring program shipped to the Codabench worker. Run it locally to reproduce server scores bit-for-bit, given a dummy reference set you generate from the released detection-test frames.
  • make_dummy_submission.py — produces a known-bad submission that exercises the format. Useful for sanity-checking your pipeline.
  • submission_format.md — full submission spec.

Held out (organizer-only)

  • 50 real frames used as the realism reference set.
  • Ground-truth boxes for the 50 detection-test frames.

Categories evaluated

This track is scored on 3 object categories defined for the V2X-Real dataset: vehicle, pedestrian, truck. The leaderboard's detection score is the mean AP across these categories; classes with zero ground-truth instances in the held-out 50-frame set are excluded from the mean.

Splits

Splits are stratified random samples with fixed seed 1234. The exact frame ID lists are published in the starting kit so anyone can reproduce them from the released real dataset.

Reference baselines

The numbers below are reported for the Car class only, taken from prior work on this dataset. The leaderboard's detection score is the mean AP across all categories defined for this track (see Evaluation), so submissions are scored on broader coverage than these single-class references. The baselines are included to demonstrate that sim → real transfer is achievable on this benchmark and to provide a per-class reference point for orientation while you iterate.

SystemCar 3D AP @ 0.5Car 3D AP @ 0.7
V2X-Real no-fusion benchmark (SECOND, real) 0.3556 n/r
SECOND (UT-V2X-Real synthetic → V2X-Real-IC, IEEE T-ITS 2026) 0.6318 n/r
pages.content_zh:
数据

V2X-Real

真实的V2X-Real数据从其原始发布以来已公开可用。我们不重新分发该数据集。参赛者必须根据其许可证直接从源获取真实数据集。

  • 来源： https://github.com/ucla-mobility/V2X-Real
  • 许可证：见来源。

为参赛者发布的资源

起始工具包（Files选项卡 → starting_kit）包含：

  • detection_test_frames/ — 50个真实激光雷达帧（仅点云，无标签），您必须在这些帧上运行检测器并提交预测。
  • detection_test_frame_ids.json — 您的predictions.json必须按顺序涵盖的规范帧ID列表。
  • forbidden_frames.txt — 100个帧ID，您不能在其上进行训练、验证或超参数调整。这是50个检测测试帧和50个真实性参考帧的并集。基于荣誉制度，由您提交中的签署声明执行。
  • local_eval.py — 发送到Codabench工作者的确切评分程序。在本地运行以从发布的检测测试帧生成虚拟参考集后，逐位重现服务器分数。
  • make_dummy_submission.py — 生成已知的不良提交来测试格式。对于验证您的管道很有用。
  • submission_format.md — 完整的提交规范。

保留（仅组织者）

  • 50个用作真实性参考集的真实帧。
  • 50个检测测试帧的真实标注框。

评估的类别

本赛道在V2X-Real数据集定义的3个目标类别上评分：车辆、行人、卡车。排行榜的检测分数是这些类别中的平均AP；在保留的50帧集中没有真实实例的类别从平均值中排除。

数据集划分

划分是使用固定种子1234的分层随机样本。精确的帧ID列表已在起始工具包中发布，以便任何人都可以从发布的真实数据集中重现它们。

参考基线

下面报告的数字仅适用于车辆类，来自该数据集上的先前工作。排行榜的检测分数是该赛道定义的所有类别的平均AP（见评估），因此提交在比这些单类参考更广泛的覆盖范围上评分。包括这些基线是为了证明模拟→真实转移在该基准上是可实现的，并为您迭代时提供每类参考点以供参考。

系统车辆3D AP @ 0.5车辆3D AP @ 0.7
V2X-Real无融合基准（SECOND，真实） 0.3556 n/r
SECOND（UT-V2X-Real合成 → V2X-Real-IC，IEEE T-ITS 2026） 0.6318 n/r

pages.title: Submission
pages.content:
Submission Format

Pack everything below into a single submission.zip and upload it on the Submit tab.

submission.zip
├── synthetic/
│   ├── 0001.bin
│   ├── 0002.bin
│   ├── ...
│   └── 0050.bin           # exactly 50 files
├── predictions.json
└── declaration.pdf        # signed honor declaration (PDF). declaration.txt also accepted.

synthetic/<id>.bin

  • Exactly 50 files.
  • Each file is raw float32, shape N × 3, in row-major order, with channels (x, y, z) in metres.
  • Either N × 3 or N × 4 (xyz + intensity) is accepted; the intensity column, if present, is dropped before scoring.
  • Each file ≤ 1.5 MB on disk (~125,000 points). Realism is computed at the dataset level: all 50 frames are concatenated, masked to the track's point-cloud range, then subsampled to 10,000 points (seed 1234) before computing CD / MMD / EMD / FPD. Submitting denser frames does not improve scores; frame ordering does not matter.
  • The simplest valid naming is 0001.bin … 0050.bin.

predictions.json

JSON object whose keys are the frame IDs from detection_test_frame_ids.json (in the starting kit). For every frame ID you must include an entry, even if the value is an empty list.

{
  "<frame_id_1>": [
    {"box": [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading], "score": 0.97, "class": "vehicle"},
    {"box": [...],                          "score": 0.81, "class": "pedestrian"}
  ],
  "<frame_id_2>": [],
  ...
}
  • box: 7 floats, OpenPCDet convention. (x, y, z) is the box center in metres in the LiDAR frame, (dx, dy, dz) are full extents along the box-local axes, heading is rotation around +Z in radians.
  • score: confidence in [0, 1].
  • class: one of the valid class strings for this track. Valid values: vehicle, pedestrian, truck. Class strings are matched case-insensitively. Predictions with unrecognized class strings are discarded before AP is computed.

declaration.pdf (or declaration.txt)

The starter kit ships declaration_template.pdf, a one-page form with the required honor statement preprinted and a signature line. Fill in team name and date, sign (digitally with any PDF tool, or print → sign → scan), save as declaration.pdf, and include it in every submission.

If you cannot easily produce a signed PDF, a plain declaration.txt is also accepted. Required statement (verbatim, case-insensitive):

I confirm that I did not train on any frame listed in forbidden_frames.txt, and that all submitted detections were produced by a model trained only on synthetic data I generated.

What gets returned

After scoring (typically < 5 minutes for valid submissions) you'll see your position on the leaderboard plus a Detailed Results view with all component metrics, including per-class AP.
pages.content_zh:
# 提交格式

将以下所有内容打包到单个 `submission.zip` 中，然后在*提交*标签页上传。

```
submission.zip
├── synthetic/
│   ├── 0001.bin
│   ├── 0002.bin
│   ├── ...
│   └── 0050.bin           # 恰好50个文件
├── predictions.json
└── declaration.pdf        # 签署的荣誉声明（PDF）。也接受 declaration.txt。
```

## synthetic/<id>.bin

- 恰好 **50** 个文件。
- 每个文件为原始 `float32` 格式，形状为 `N × 3`，按行主序存储，通道为 `(x, y, z)`（单位：米）。
- 接受 `N × 3` 或 `N × 4`（xyz + 强度）格式；若存在强度列，计分前会将其丢弃。
- 每个文件 ≤ 1.5 MB（约 125,000 个点）。真实感在数据集级别计算：将所有 50 帧连接，遮罩到轨迹的点云范围，然后下采样到 10,000 个点（种子 1234），再计算 CD / MMD / EMD / FPD。提交更密集的帧不会改善分数；帧顺序无关。
- 最简单的有效命名为 `0001.bin … 0050.bin`。

## predictions.json

JSON 对象，其键为 `detection_test_frame_ids.json`（在初始工具包中）中的帧 ID。对每个帧 ID 必须包含一个条目，即使值为空列表也是如此。

```
{
  "<frame_id_1>": [
    {"box": [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading], "score": 0.97, "class": "vehicle"},
    {"box": [...],                          "score": 0.81, "class": "pedestrian"}
  ],
  "<frame_id_2>": [],
  ...
}
```

- `box`：7 个浮点数，遵循 OpenPCDet 规范。`(x, y, z)` 是盒子*中心*在 LiDAR 坐标系中的位置（单位：米），`(dx, dy, dz)` 是沿盒子局部轴的完整尺寸，`heading` 是围绕 `+Z` 的旋转（单位：弧度）。
- `score`：置信度，范围 [0, 1]。
- `class`：此轨迹的有效类别字符串之一。有效值：`vehicle`（车辆）、`pedestrian`（行人）、`truck`（卡车）。类别字符串匹配不区分大小写。计算 AP 前会丢弃具有无法识别类别字符串的预测。

## declaration.pdf（或 declaration.txt）

初始工具包包含 `declaration_template.pdf`，这是一份单页表单，具有预先打印的必需荣誉声明和签名行。填入团队名称和日期，签署（使用任何 PDF 工具进行数字签名，或打印 → 签署 → 扫描），另存为 `declaration.pdf`，并将其包含在每次提交中。

如果无法轻松生成签署的 PDF，也接受纯文本 `declaration.txt`。必需声明（逐字，不区分大小写）：

> *我确认我没有对 `forbidden_frames.txt` 中列出的任何帧进行训练，且所有提交的检测都是由仅在我生成的合成数据上训练的模型生成的。*

## 返回内容

评分后（有效提交通常 < 5 分钟），您将在排行榜上看到您的位置，以及包含所有组件指标的*详细结果*视图，包括按类别的 AP。

pages.title: Rules
pages.content:
Rules

Eligibility

  • Open to anyone — researchers, students, industry teams.
  • Each team must register one participant account; do not maintain multiple accounts.

Allowed

  • Any simulation framework or generative model (CARLA, Helios++, OpenScene, neural radiance fields, diffusion, GANs, custom physics). Open or closed source — what matters is the synthesized data.
  • Any 3D object detector architecture, trained on your synthetic data only.
  • Augmentations applied during detector training (rotation, scale, flip, ground-truth sampling, noise) — they operate on synthetic data, not on the forbidden real frames.
  • Using the train split of the public real dataset for hyperparameter selection or domain adaptation, provided no forbidden frame is touched. (The forbidden list contains only the 100 reserved frames, not the entire real train split.)

Forbidden

  • Training, validating, hyperparameter-tuning, or otherwise observing ground truth from any of the 100 frames listed in forbidden_frames.txt. This is enforced by signed declaration and is the foundational integrity rule of the challenge.
  • Submitting predictions produced by a model that has been trained on real labels for any roadside-LiDAR dataset. The detector must be sim-only.
  • Reverse-engineering or inferring the held-out realism reference frames via Codabench's leaderboard signal (e.g., probing submissions designed to leak the reference set's identity). Submissions found to be doing this will be disqualified.
  • Multiple accounts, sub-team accounts, or coordinating across registered teams.

Disqualification

Organizers reserve the right to inspect the synthetic frames and predictions of any submission for evidence of forbidden-frame leakage (e.g., synthetic frames that suspiciously resemble held-out real frames; predictions whose distribution implies access to held-out ground truth). Disqualified participants are removed from the leaderboard and from prize consideration.

Prizes

Per track: 1st place USD 500, 2nd place USD 300, 3rd place USD 200. Sponsor(s) will be announced before the Development phase opens.

Publication and credit

  • Every participating team submits a 4–8 page challenge report describing their approach.
  • Teams that prefer not to publish may opt into the workshop's non-publication track for their submission.
  • Top-3 teams per track are additionally invited to submit a full paper to the proceedings track of the next edition of the DriveX Workshop.
  • The challenge organizers may publish an aggregate analysis of all submissions (anonymized unless explicit permission is granted).
pages.content_zh:
规则

参赛资格

  • 面向所有人开放——研究人员、学生、产业团队均可参赛。
  • 每个团队必须注册一个参赛者账户，不得维持多个账户。

允许的内容

  • 任何仿真框架或生成模型（CARLA、Helios++、OpenScene、神经辐射场、扩散模型、GAN、自定义物理引擎）。开源或闭源均可——重要的是合成数据的质量。
  • 任何3D目标检测器架构，仅在你自己生成的合成数据上训练。
  • 检测器训练过程中应用的数据增强（旋转、缩放、翻转、真值采样、噪声）——这些操作作用于合成数据，而非禁止的真实图像。
  • 使用公共真实数据集的训练集进行超参数选择或域适应，条件是不接触任何禁止的图像。（禁止列表仅包含100个保留帧，不包括整个真实训练集。）

禁止的内容

  • 对forbidden_frames.txt中列出的任何100帧进行训练、验证、超参数调整或以其他方式观察其真值标注。这由签署声明强制执行，是本挑战赛的基础完整性规则。
  • 提交由在任何路侧激光雷达数据集的真实标签上训练过的模型所生成的预测结果。检测器必须仅基于仿真数据。
  • 通过Codabench排行榜信号逆向工程或推断被保留的真实参考帧（例如，设计用于泄露参考集身份的探测性提交）。发现进行此操作的提交将被取消资格。
  • 多个账户、子团队账户或已注册团队间的协调。

取消资格

组织者保留权利检查任何提交的合成图像和预测结果，以寻找禁止帧泄露的证据（例如，与被保留真实图像可疑相似的合成帧；其分布暗示获得了被保留真值标注的预测）。被取消资格的参赛者将从排行榜和奖项考虑中被移除。

奖金

每个赛道：第1名USD 500，第2名USD 300，第3名USD 200。赞助商信息将在开发阶段开始前公布。

发表与署名

  • 每支参赛团队提交一份4–8页的挑战赛报告，描述其方法。
  • 不愿发表的团队可选择参加研讨会的非发表赛道。
  • 每个赛道的前3名团队另外邀请向下一届DriveX研讨会论文集赛道提交完整论文。
  • 挑战赛组织者可发表所有提交的汇总分析（匿名处理，除非获得明确授权）。

# LiDAR数据合成

针对LUMPI汉诺威路边交叉口分布的LiDAR数据合成；在合成数据上训练，在真实数据上评估。

---

pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge — LUMPI Track

Muhammad Shahbaz  ·  Shaurya Agarwal

A challenge track of the 6th DriveX Workshop @ ECCV 2026 — drivex-workshop.github.io/eccv2026.

Roadside LiDAR perception for intelligent transportation systems is bottlenecked by the cost and rarity of large, well-annotated real datasets. This challenge asks: can synthetic LiDAR data be made realistic enough that a deep learning model trained on it generalizes to real LiDAR frames?

Towards that, this challenge asks participants to generate their own synthetic LiDAR data targeting the LUMPI distribution, train an object detector on that data, and submit detections on real held-out frames. We score on (1) how distributionally close their synthetic frames are to real ones, and (2) how well the sim-only detector performs on real frames.

Reference resources for participants

To support participants who would like a documented starting point, we make publicly available a complete reference pipeline covering synthesis methodology, empirical analysis, ready-to-use synthetic datasets, and an open-source LiDAR data processing and visualization software. These materials are offered as orientation, not as requirements.

The synthesis pipeline is described in UrbanTwin: Building High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Sim2Real LiDAR Perception and Evaluation (arXiv preprint), with a deeper empirical analysis including the distributional realism metrics adopted by this challenge in High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Bridging the Sim2Real Gap in LiDAR-Based ITS Perception (IEEE T-ITS, 2026).

The synthetic LiDAR datasets generated with that pipeline are released in UrbanTwin: Synthetic Roadside LiDAR Datasets (IEEE OJ-ITS, 2026) and are available for download at Harvard Dataverse. Each dataset contains 10K frames annotated across six object categories for detection, tracking, and segmentation tasks, and is directly compatible with the multi-class evaluation used here; empirical analysis in papers include both the distributional realism metrics and single-class 3D object detection study as proof-of-concept. For end-to-end LiDAR processing we also provide our LiGuard Framework (IEEE T-IV, 2026) with short, more software focused read on The Journal of Open Source Software.

What you will do

  1. Download the public real LUMPI dataset and the released detection-test point clouds (50 real frames, no labels).
  2. Generate synthetic LiDAR frames using any approach you like — simulation (CARLA, LGSVL, custom), generative models (diffusion, GANs, flow-based), hybrid pipelines, or anything else.
  3. Train a 3D object detector (any architecture) on only your synthetic data.
  4. Submit:
    • 50 of your synthetic LiDAR frames,
    • your detector's predictions on the 50 released test point clouds,
    • and a signed honor declaration.

Scoring at a glance

Combined score = 0.6 × normalized 3D mAP + 0.4 × normalized realism, where 3D mAP is averaged across the 8 object categories defined for this track (Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown) and realism averages normalized Chamfer Distance, MMD, EMD, and Fréchet Point-cloud Distance. See the Evaluation tab for the formulae.

Prizes

Per track:

  • 1st place: USD 500
  • 2nd place: USD 300
  • 3rd place: USD 200

Sponsor(s) will be announced before the Development phase opens.

Phases

  • Development — public leaderboard, up to 5 submissions/day per participant, 100 total. Use this to iterate.
  • Final — private leaderboard until close, 5 total submissions per participant. The final-phase ranking determines the winners.

Baselines

Reference numbers are listed in the Data tab.
pages.content_zh:
# UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR 挑战赛 — LUMPI 赛道

*第6届DriveX工作坊 @ ECCV 2026 的挑战赛道 — [drivex-workshop.github.io/eccv2026](https://drivex-workshop.github.io/eccv2026)*

路边LiDAR感知在智能交通系统中的发展受到大规模、标注完善的真实数据集成本高且稀缺的制约。本挑战赛提出：能否使合成LiDAR数据达到足够的真实性，使得在其上训练的深度学习模型能够泛化到真实LiDAR帧？

为此，本挑战赛要求参与者针对**LUMPI**分布生成自己的合成LiDAR数据、在该数据上训练目标检测器，并在真实的保留测试帧上提交检测结果。评分基于：(1) 其合成帧与真实帧的分布接近程度，以及 (2) 仅在合成数据上训练的检测器在真实帧上的性能。

## 参与者参考资源

为支持寻求文档化起点的参与者，我们公开提供了一套完整的参考管道，涵盖合成方法、经验分析、即用型合成数据集和开源LiDAR数据处理与可视化软件。这些资料作为参考方向提供，而非强制要求。

合成管道在《[UrbanTwin: 为Sim2Real LiDAR感知与评估构建高保真数字孪生体](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.02903)》(arXiv预印本)中描述，更深入的经验分析包括本挑战赛所采用的分布真实性指标，详见《[高保真数字孪生体缩小LiDAR基础智能交通感知中的Sim2Real差距](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?oi=bibs&cluster=6844982498826808010&btnI=1&hl=en)》(IEEE T-ITS, 2026)。

使用该管道生成的合成LiDAR数据集发布在《[UrbanTwin: 合成路边LiDAR数据集](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/iel8/8784355/8957420/11357520.pdf)》(IEEE OJ-ITS, 2026)中，可从[哈佛数据库](https://dataverse.harvard.edu/dataverse/ucf-ut)下载。每个数据集包含**10K帧**，跨越**6个目标类别**，用于**检测、跟踪和分割任务**，与本挑战赛使用的多类评估完全兼容；论文中的经验分析既包括分布真实性指标，也包括单类3D目标检测研究作为概念验证。对于端到端LiDAR处理，我们还提供了[LiGuard框架](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11498694)(IEEE T-IV, 2026)以及更加软件聚焦的简明读物《[开源软件期刊](https://joss.theoj.org/papers/10.21105/joss.06751.pdf)》。

## 你将执行的步骤

1. 下载公开真实**LUMPI**数据集和发布的检测测试点云(50个真实帧，无标签)。
2. 使用任何方法生成合成LiDAR帧 — 模拟(CARLA、LGSVL、自定义)、生成模型(扩散、GANs、流基模型)、混合管道或其他任何方法。
3. 在**仅你的合成数据**上训练3D目标检测器(任何架构)。
4. 提交：
   - 50个你的合成LiDAR帧
   - 你的检测器在50个发布测试点云上的预测结果
   - 一份签署的诚信声明

## 评分概览

综合评分 = `0.6 × 归一化3D mAP` + `0.4 × 归一化真实性`，其中3D mAP在本赛道定义的**8个**目标类别(*行人、汽车、自行车、摩托车、公交车、卡车、货车、未知*)上平均，真实性平均归一化的Chamfer距离、MMD、EMD和Fr

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
Evaluation Protocol

Two scores are computed and combined into a single Combined score that determines leaderboard rank.

1. Distributional realism

Aggregation:

  1. Concatenate the 50 submitted synthetic frames into one set S_syn; concatenate the 50 held-out real reference frames into S_real.
  2. Mask both to the point-cloud range [-40, -40, -5, 40, 40, 5].
  3. Subsample uniformly at random to N = 10,000 points per side, with seed 1234 (identical seed used by the local evaluator in the starter kit).
  4. Compute one CD, MMD, EMD, and FPD across the entire 10,000-point sets.

1a. Chamfer Distance (CD)

CD(P, Q) = (1/|P|) Σ_{p ∈ P} min_{q ∈ Q} ||p - q||²
         + (1/|Q|) Σ_{q ∈ Q} min_{p ∈ P} ||p - q||²

Squared-L2 nearest-neighbor cost; symmetric. Lower is better.

1b. Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD)

MMD²(X, Y) = E[k(x, x')] + E[k(y, y')] - 2 E[k(x, y)],   k(a, b) = exp(-γ ||a - b||²)

Unbiased estimator (off-diagonal). Bandwidth γ is set by the median heuristic on a 1 000-point joint subsample (γ = 1 / (2 · median ||x - y||²)) so the kernel does not saturate at LiDAR spatial scales. Lower is better.

1c. Earth Mover's Distance (EMD)

EMD(X, Y) = √ ( min_{T ∈ Π(X, Y)} Σ_{i,j} T_{ij} · ||x_i - y_j|| )

Wasserstein-1 with Euclidean ground cost, solved exactly by the network simplex (POT's ot.emd2). Reported in metres. Lower is better.

1d. Fréchet Point-cloud Distance (FPD)

FPD = ||μ_X - μ_Y||² + Tr(Σ_X + Σ_Y - 2 (Σ_X · Σ_Y)^{1/2})

FID-style: fits a 3-variate Gaussian to each set's points, computes the 2-Wasserstein between Gaussians. Lower is better.

2. 3D Object Detection

Participants submit detections (predictions.json) on 50 real LiDAR frames whose ground truth is held out. We compute average precision over the 8 object categories defined for this track (Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown), at IoU thresholds 0.5 (primary) and 0.7 (secondary). Per-class AP is reported, and mean AP across classes (mAP) is the leaderboard's detection score; classes with zero ground-truth instances in the held-out set are excluded from the mean. Both KITTI 11-point and 40-point interpolated AP are reported; the 40-point form is the leaderboard primary.

Ground-truth and predicted boxes use the OpenPCDet 7-DoF format [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading]. IoU is computed as 3D intersection-over-union between two oriented BEV rectangles times the Z overlap. The KITTI truncation/occlusion/min-height difficulty filter is not applied because those depend on 2D bounding-box annotations that are not natural for roadside LiDAR datasets.

The valid class strings for this track are listed in config.json (shipped in reference_data/) and in submission_format.md in the starter kit. Any prediction with an unrecognized class label is discarded.

3. Combined score

Each component is min-max normalized into [0, 1] using a per-track normalization range:

score_realism   = mean( norm(CD), norm(MMD), norm(EMD), norm(FPD) )    (lower-is-better → 1 - clip)
score_detection = norm( AP_3d @ IoU 0.5 )                               (higher-is-better → clip)
score_combined  = 0.6 · score_detection + 0.4 · score_realism

Normalization endpoints are public in config.json (shipped in reference_data/), so the local evaluator and the server compute identical scores.

Reproducibility

  • Realism is dataset-level — frame ordering does not matter. Submit the 50 synthetic frames in any consistent naming.
  • Subsampling RNG seed: 1234 (same on server and starting kit).
  • The exact scoring program shipped to the Codabench worker is included in the starting kit.
pages.content_zh:
# 评估协议

计算两个分数并将其合并为单一的综合分数 以确定排行榜排名。

1. 分布真实性

聚合：

  1. 将50个提交的合成帧连接成一个集合 S_syn；将50个保留的真实参考帧 连接成S_real。
  2. 将两者都掩盖到点云范围 [-40, -40, -5, 40, 40, 5]。
  3. 以种子1234均匀随机子采样到每侧N = 10,000个点 （启动工具包中的本地评估器使用相同种子）。
  4. 在整个10,000点集上计算一个CD、MMD、EMD和FPD。

1a. 倒角距离（CD）

CD(P, Q) = (1/|P|) Σ_{p ∈ P} min_{q ∈ Q} ||p - q||²
         + (1/|Q|) Σ_{q ∈ Q} min_{p ∈ P} ||p - q||²

平方L2最近邻成本；对称的。数值越小越好。

1b. 最大均值差异（MMD）

MMD²(X, Y) = E[k(x, x')] + E[k(y, y')] - 2 E[k(x, y)],   k(a, b) = exp(-γ ||a - b||²)

无偏估计量（非对角线）。带宽γ通过1000点联合子样本上的中值启发式设置 （γ = 1 / (2 · median ||x - y||²)），以便核在LiDAR空间尺度上不饱和。数值越小越好。

1c. 地球移动距离（EMD）

EMD(X, Y) = √ ( min_{T ∈ Π(X, Y)} Σ_{i,j} T_{ij} · ||x_i - y_j|| )

Wasserstein-1距离，欧几里得地面成本，通过网络单纯形精确求解（POT的ot.emd2）。以米为单位报告。数值越小越好。

1d. 弗雷歇点云距离（FPD）

FPD = ||μ_X - μ_Y||² + Tr(Σ_X + Σ_Y - 2 (Σ_X · Σ_Y)^{1/2})

FID风格：对每个集合的点拟合3变量高斯分布，计算高斯分布之间的2-Wasserstein距离。数值越小越好。

2. 3D物体检测

参与者在50个真实LiDAR帧上提交检测结果（predictions.json），这些帧的真实标注被保留。我们在为该赛道定义的8个物体类别上计算平均精度 （行人、汽车、自行车、摩托车、公交车、卡车、货车、未知），IoU阈值为0.5（主要）和0.7 （次要）。报告每个类别的AP，以及各类别的平均AP （mAP）是排行榜检测分数；保留集中零个真实标注实例的类别被排除在平均值之外。报告KITTI 11点和40点插值AP；40点形式是排行榜主要指标。

真实标注框和预测框使用OpenPCDet 7自由度格式 [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading]。IoU计算为两个有向BEV矩形之间的3D交并比乘以Z重叠。未应用KITTI截断/遮挡/最小高度难度过滤器，因为这些取决于对于路边LiDAR数据集不太自然的2D边界框注释。

该赛道的有效类别字符串在 config.json中列出（在reference_data/中提供）以及 启动工具包中的submission_format.md。任何带有无法识别的类别标签的预测都被丢弃。

3. 综合分数

使用每条赛道的归一化范围将每个分量最大-最小归一化为[0, 1]：

score_realism   = mean( norm(CD), norm(MMD), norm(EMD), norm(FPD) )    (数值越小越好 → 1 - clip)
score_detection = norm( AP_3d @ IoU 0.5 )                               (数值越大越好 → clip)
score_combined  = 0.6 · score_detection + 0.4 · score_realism

归一化端点在config.json中公开（在reference_data/中提供），因此本地评估器和服务器

pages.title: Data
pages.content:
Data

LUMPI

Real LUMPI data is publicly available from its original release. We do not redistribute it. Participants must obtain the real dataset directly from its source under its own license.

  • Source: https://data.uni-hannover.de/dataset/lumpi
  • License: see the source.

Released for participants

The starting kit (Files tab → starting_kit) contains:

  • detection_test_frames/ — 50 real LiDAR frames (point clouds only, no labels) on which you must run your detector and submit predictions.
  • detection_test_frame_ids.json — the canonical list of frame IDs your predictions.json must cover, in order.
  • forbidden_frames.txt — 100 frame IDs you may not train, validate, or hyperparameter-tune on. This is the union of the 50 detection-test frames and the 50 realism-reference frames. Honor system, enforced by signed declaration in your submission.
  • local_eval.py — the exact scoring program shipped to the Codabench worker. Run it locally to reproduce server scores bit-for-bit, given a dummy reference set you generate from the released detection-test frames.
  • make_dummy_submission.py — produces a known-bad submission that exercises the format. Useful for sanity-checking your pipeline.
  • submission_format.md — full submission spec.

Held out (organizer-only)

  • 50 real frames used as the realism reference set.
  • Ground-truth boxes for the 50 detection-test frames.

Categories evaluated

This track is scored on 8 object categories defined for the LUMPI dataset: Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown. The leaderboard's detection score is the mean AP across these categories; classes with zero ground-truth instances in the held-out 50-frame set are excluded from the mean.

Splits

Splits are stratified random samples with fixed seed 1234. The exact frame ID lists are published in the starting kit so anyone can reproduce them from the released real dataset.

Reference baselines

The numbers below are reported for the Car class only, taken from prior work on this dataset. The leaderboard's detection score is the mean AP across all categories defined for this track (see Evaluation), so submissions are scored on broader coverage than these single-class references. The baselines are included to demonstrate that sim → real transfer is achievable on this benchmark and to provide a per-class reference point for orientation while you iterate.

SystemCar 3D AP @ 0.5Car 3D AP @ 0.7
SEED (real LUMPI training, IEEE T-ITS 2026) 0.4270 n/r
SEED (UT-LUMPI synthetic → real LUMPI, IEEE T-ITS 2026) 0.4474 n/r

数据

LUMPI

真实的 LUMPI 数据可从其原始发布源公开获取。我们不重新分发这些数据。参赛者必须根据其许可证直接从源获取真实数据集。

  • 来源： https://data.uni-hannover.de/dataset/lumpi
  • 许可证： 见源站点。

为参赛者发布的内容

起始工具包（Files 选项卡 → starting_kit）包含：

  • detection_test_frames/ —— 50个真实激光雷达帧（仅点云，无标注），你必须在其上运行检测器并提交预测结果。
  • detection_test_frame_ids.json —— 你的 predictions.json 必须覆盖的规范帧ID列表，按顺序排列。
  • forbidden_frames.txt —— 100个帧ID，你不得用于训练、验证或超参数调优。这是50个检测测试帧和50个真实性参考帧的并集。采用荣誉制，通过提交中的签署声明来执行。
  • local_eval.py —— 部署到Codabench worker的确切评分程序。在本地运行以重现服务器评分结果（精确到位），需要从发布的检测测试帧生成虚拟参考集。
  • make_dummy_submission.py —— 生成已知不良提交以测试格式。用于完整性检查你的处理流程。
  • submission_format.md —— 完整提交规范。

保留数据（仅组织者可见）

  • 50个真实帧用作真实性参考集。
  • 50个检测测试帧的真实标注框。

评估类别

该赛道对LUMPI数据集定义的8个对象类别进行评分： 行人、汽车、自行车、摩托车、公交车、卡车、货车、未知。排行榜的检测评分是这些类别的平均AP；在保留的50帧集中没有真实实例的类别从平均值中排除。

数据划分

划分为使用固定种子1234的分层随机样本。确切的帧ID列表已在起始工具包中发布，任何人都可以从发布的真实数据集中重现它们。

参考基线

下面的数字仅针对汽车类别报告，取自该数据集的先前研究。排行榜的检测评分是该赛道定义的所有类别的平均AP（见评估），因此提交内容按比这些单类参考更广泛的范围进行评分。包含这些基线是为了证明模拟→真实迁移在此基准上是可行的，并在你迭代时提供单类参考点以供参考。

pages.title: Submission
pages.content:
Submission Format

Pack everything below into a single submission.zip and upload it on the Submit tab.

submission.zip
├── synthetic/
│   ├── 0001.bin
│   ├── 0002.bin
│   ├── ...
│   └── 0050.bin           # exactly 50 files
├── predictions.json
└── declaration.pdf        # signed honor declaration (PDF). declaration.txt also accepted.

synthetic/<id>.bin

  • Exactly 50 files.
  • Each file is raw float32, shape N × 3, in row-major order, with channels (x, y, z) in metres.
  • Either N × 3 or N × 4 (xyz + intensity) is accepted; the intensity column, if present, is dropped before scoring.
  • Each file ≤ 1.5 MB on disk (~125,000 points). Realism is computed at the dataset level: all 50 frames are concatenated, masked to the track's point-cloud range, then subsampled to 10,000 points (seed 1234) before computing CD / MMD / EMD / FPD. Submitting denser frames does not improve scores; frame ordering does not matter.
  • The simplest valid naming is 0001.bin … 0050.bin.

predictions.json

JSON object whose keys are the frame IDs from detection_test_frame_ids.json (in the starting kit). For every frame ID you must include an entry, even if the value is an empty list.

{
  "<frame_id_1>": [
    {"box": [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading], "score": 0.97, "class": "Car"},
    {"box": [...],                          "score": 0.81, "class": "Person"}
  ],
  "<frame_id_2>": [],
  ...
}
  • box: 7 floats, OpenPCDet convention. (x, y, z) is the box center in metres in the LiDAR frame, (dx, dy, dz) are full extents along the box-local axes, heading is rotation around +Z in radians.
  • score: confidence in [0, 1].
  • class: one of the valid class strings for this track. Valid values: Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown. Class strings are matched case-insensitively. Predictions with unrecognized class strings are discarded before AP is computed.

declaration.pdf (or declaration.txt)

The starter kit ships declaration_template.pdf, a one-page form with the required honor statement preprinted and a signature line. Fill in team name and date, sign (digitally with any PDF tool, or print → sign → scan), save as declaration.pdf, and include it in every submission.

If you cannot easily produce a signed PDF, a plain declaration.txt is also accepted. Required statement (verbatim, case-insensitive):

I confirm that I did not train on any frame listed in forbidden_frames.txt, and that all submitted detections were produced by a model trained only on synthetic data I generated.

What gets returned

After scoring (typically < 5 minutes for valid submissions) you'll see your position on the leaderboard plus a Detailed Results view with all component metrics, including per-class AP.
pages.content_zh:
提交格式

将以下所有内容打包到单个 submission.zip 文件中，并在提交标签页上传。

submission.zip
├── synthetic/
│   ├── 0001.bin
│   ├── 0002.bin
│   ├── ...
│   └── 0050.bin           # 恰好 50 个文件
├── predictions.json
└── declaration.pdf        # 已签署的诚信声明（PDF）。也接受 declaration.txt。

synthetic/<id>.bin

  • 恰好50个文件。
  • 每个文件为原始 float32 格式，形状 N × 3，按行主序排列，通道为 (x, y, z)（单位：米）。
  • 接受 N × 3 或 N × 4（xyz + 强度）格式；如果存在强度列，在评分前将被删除。
  • 每个文件 ≤ 1.5 MB（约 125,000 个点）。真实性在数据集级别计算：将所有 50 帧连接、掩膜至轨迹的点云范围，然后子采样至 10,000 个点（种子 1234），之后计算 CD / MMD / EMD / FPD。提交更密集的帧不会改善分数；帧顺序不重要。
  • 最简单的有效命名方式是 0001.bin … 0050.bin。

predictions.json

JSON 对象，其键为来自 detection_test_frame_ids.json（在起始工具包中）的帧 ID。对于每个帧 ID，必须包含一个条目，即使值为空列表也是如此。

{
  "<frame_id_1>": [
    {"box": [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading], "score": 0.97, "class": "Car"},
    {"box": [...],                          "score": 0.81, "class": "Person"}
  ],
  "<frame_id_2>": [],
  ...
}
  • box：7 个浮点数，OpenPCDet 约定。(x, y, z) 是 LiDAR 框架中的框中心（单位：米），(dx, dy, dz) 是沿框局部轴的完整范围，heading 是围绕 +Z 轴的旋转角度（单位：弧度）。
  • score：置信度，范围 [0, 1]。
  • class：该轨迹的有效类别字符串之一。有效值为：Person、Car、Bicycle、Motorcycle、Bus、Truck、Van、Unknown。类别字符串匹配不区分大小写。具有无法识别的类别字符串的预测在计算 AP 前将被丢弃。

declaration.pdf（或 declaration.txt）

起始工具包附带 declaration_template.pdf，一份单页表单，具有预印的必需诚信声明和签名行。填写团队名称和日期，签名（用任何 PDF 工具进行数字签名，或打印 → 签名 → 扫描），另存为 declaration.pdf，并将其包含在每次提交中。

如果无法轻松生成已签署的 PDF，也接受纯文本 declaration.txt。必需声明（逐字，不区分大小写）：

I confirm that I did not train on any frame listed in forbidden_frames.txt, and that all submitted detections were produced by a model trained only on synthetic data I generated.

返回结果

评分后（通常对于有效提交耗时 < 5 分钟），您将在排行榜上看到您的排名，以及详细结果视图，其中包含所有组件指标，包括按类别的 AP。

pages.title: Rules
pages.content:
Rules

Eligibility

  • Open to anyone — researchers, students, industry teams.
  • Each team must register one participant account; do not maintain multiple accounts.

Allowed

  • Any simulation framework or generative model (CARLA, Helios++, OpenScene, neural radiance fields, diffusion, GANs, custom physics). Open or closed source — what matters is the synthesized data.
  • Any 3D object detector architecture, trained on your synthetic data only.
  • Augmentations applied during detector training (rotation, scale, flip, ground-truth sampling, noise) — they operate on synthetic data, not on the forbidden real frames.
  • Using the train split of the public real dataset for hyperparameter selection or domain adaptation, provided no forbidden frame is touched. (The forbidden list contains only the 100 reserved frames, not the entire real train split.)

Forbidden

  • Training, validating, hyperparameter-tuning, or otherwise observing ground truth from any of the 100 frames listed in forbidden_frames.txt. This is enforced by signed declaration and is the foundational integrity rule of the challenge.
  • Submitting predictions produced by a model that has been trained on real labels for any roadside-LiDAR dataset. The detector must be sim-only.
  • Reverse-engineering or inferring the held-out realism reference frames via Codabench's leaderboard signal (e.g., probing submissions designed to leak the reference set's identity). Submissions found to be doing this will be disqualified.
  • Multiple accounts, sub-team accounts, or coordinating across registered teams.

Disqualification

Organizers reserve the right to inspect the synthetic frames and predictions of any submission for evidence of forbidden-frame leakage (e.g., synthetic frames that suspiciously resemble held-out real frames; predictions whose distribution implies access to held-out ground truth). Disqualified participants are removed from the leaderboard and from prize consideration.

Prizes

Per track: 1st place USD 500, 2nd place USD 300, 3rd place USD 200. Sponsor(s) will be announced before the Development phase opens.

Publication and credit

  • Every participating team submits a 4–8 page challenge report describing their approach.
  • Teams that prefer not to publish may opt into the workshop's non-publication track for their submission.
  • Top-3 teams per track are additionally invited to submit a full paper to the proceedings track of the next edition of the DriveX Workshop.
  • The challenge organizers may publish an aggregate analysis of all submissions (anonymized unless explicit permission is granted).
pages.content_zh:
# 规则

## 参赛资格
- 面向所有人开放——研究人员、学生、行业团队。
- 每支团队必须注册一个参赛者账户；不得维护多个账户。

## 允许的做法
- 任何仿真框架或生成模型（CARLA、Helios++、OpenScene、神经辐射场、扩散模型、GAN、自定义物理引擎）。开源或闭源都可以——重要的是合成数据。
- 任何3D目标检测器架构，仅在**你的合成数据上**训练。
- 检测器训练期间应用的数据增强（旋转、缩放、翻转、真值采样、噪声）——它们作用于合成数据，不作用于禁用的真实帧。
- 使用公开真实数据集的**训练集分割**进行超参数选择或域适应，**前提是不涉及禁用帧**。（禁用列表仅包含100个预留帧，不包含整个真实训练集分割。）

## 禁止的做法
- 对`forbidden_frames.txt`中列出的**任何**100个帧进行训练、验证、超参数调优或以其他方式观察真值。这由签署声明强制执行，是该竞赛的基础诚信规则。
- 提交由在**任何**路边LiDAR数据集的真实标签上训练过的模型产生的预测。检测器必须仅限于仿真。
- 通过Codabench排行榜信号逆向工程或推断保留的真实参考帧（例如，提交设计用于泄露参考集身份的预测）。发现进行此操作的提交将被取消资格。
- 多个账户、子团队账户或注册团队间的协调。

## 取消资格
组织者保留权利检查任何提交的合成帧和预测，以确认是否存在禁用帧泄露的证据（例如，与保留真实帧异常相似的合成帧；其分布表明可以访问保留真值的预测）。被取消资格的参赛者将从排行榜和奖金考虑中移除。

## 奖项
每个赛道：第1名USD 500、第2名USD 300、第3名USD 200。赞助商将在开发阶段开始前公布。

## 发布和署名
- 每支参赛团队提交一份**4–8页竞赛报告**，描述其方法。
- 倾向于不发布的团队可选择加入车间的**非发布赛道**进行提交。
- 每个赛道排名前3的团队另外被邀请提交完整论文至**下一届DriveX车间论文集赛道**。
- 竞赛组织者可发布所有提交的汇总分析（匿名处理，除非获得明确许可）。

pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
##
[MICCAI FLARE26](https://flare-medfm.github.io/) Task 2: AutoMSC: Automated Medical image Segmentation and Classification
Deep learning models for 3D medical imaging have traditionally been handcrafted for individual tasks, either segmentation or classification, requiring extensive manual tuning of architectures, hyperparameters, and preprocessing pipelines. As clinical datasets grow in scale and complexity, this manual design process becomes increasingly inefficient and limits the deployment of adaptable, general-purpose models. Motivated by the success of the Medical Segmentation Decathlon challenge and nnU-Net (the winning solution), Task 2 focuses on building self-configured models capable of automatically adapting to diverse 3D medical imaging datasets while simultaneously performing both segmentation and classification. This task aims to advance the next generation of autonomous modeldesign systems for 3D medical imaging. Participants are required to design models that can automatically infer optimal configurations (e.g., architecture, resolution, patch size, normalization strategy, and loss balancing) and jointly learn highquality segmentation masks and clinically meaningful classification labels. These models should generalize across imaging modality, tumor types without taskspecific manual engineering, including prostate cancer recurrence prediction in MRI scans, lung nodule diagnosis in CT scans, and liver metastasis origin prediction in PET/CT scans. Key Features: - **Multi-task Learning**: Models must perform both 3D segmentation and classification from the same input volume, optimizing for accuracy in both outputs while maintaining computational efficiency. - **Self-configuration**: Solutions should include automated configuration mechanisms capable of adapting to dataset properties, such as voxel spacing, image size, contrast variability, and class imbalance, without human-designed heuristics. - **Dataset Diversity**: The benchmark includes heterogeneous 3D medical imaging scans with varying modalities (CT, MRI, and PET-CT) and classification targets, encouraging the development of truly generalizable 3D models. - **Robustness and Efficiency**: Models will be evaluated on segmentation accuracy (DSC and NSD), classification performance (balanced accuracy and AUROC), and resource efficiency (runtime), highlighting their potential for real-world clinical adoption. Participants are also encouraged to explore other challenge tracks at https://flare-medfm.github.io/, including: pan-cancer segmentation, and multimodal models. --- ## 🚀 Join the challenge (Open on 2026.04.01) * Register an account on this website and join the challenge * Fill out the [registration form](https://forms.gle/my1MimQ758oDyhWb9) Note: To change team information, please simply re-submit the form. * Request Dataset [FLARE-AutoMSC](https://huggingface.co/datasets/FLARE-MedFM/FLARE-AutoMSC). We will approve your request in 1-2 working days after reviewing your application. Remarks: * This challenge has two tracks: 1) Unified models for joint segmentation and classification (e.g., [JSC](https://github.com/bowang-lab/JSC)). 2) Independent models for segmentation (e.g., [nnUNet](https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/nnUNet)) or classification ([nnClass](https://github.com/bowang-lab/nnClass)). Participants can join one track or both tracks. * For both tracks, solutions should include automated configuration mechanisms capable of adapting to different datasets. * If you have any questions that are not listed on the QA page, please reach out to chingyuanyu.iec@gmail.com --- ## 🏊‍ Validation submission (2026.4.15-8.05) * All teams can directly submit the validation results on the challenge page to get the metrics. * All the ground truth files have been released for validation tasks. participants should report validation performance in the manuscript. --- ## 🏹 Testing submission (2026.8.05-8.20) The submitted Docker container will be evaluated with the following commands. If the Docker container does not work or the paper does not include all the necessary information to reproduce the method, we will return back the error information and review comments to participants. docker load -i teamname.tar.gz docker container run --gpus "device=1" -m 28G --name teamname --rm -v \$PWD/FLARE_Test/:/workspace/inputs/ -v \$PWD/teamname_outputs/:/workspace/outputs/ teamname:latest /bin/bash -c "sh predict.sh" ## Paper submission(Due on 8.31) Please parepare the paper with this [template-tbd]() and submit it on [openreview](https://openreview.net/group) by Aug. 31, 2026. Please carefully read the template and the common issue before writing the manuscript. The evaluation process mainly focuses on the paper's completeness. Don't worry about the low performance. Since this task is very challenging, all attempts are worth sharing with readers. We will not reject papers because of Iow performance. --- ## 🏆 Awards - If there are more than 20 testing docker submissions, we will provide cash prizes for the top 5 teams (Amazon gift cards with 300/200/150/100/100 CAD, respectively) and souvenirs for the top 6-10 teams. Otherwise, only the winning team will be provided with the cash prize. - The top 5 teams will be invited to give oral presentations during MICCAI 2026. - The first author of the top 5 teams will be invited to contribute to a challenge summary paper. - A certificate will be awarded to the top 10 teams. (Top teams should make their code publicly available on GitHub for reproducibility.) - All teams have the opportunity to publish their methods in the challenge proceeding (Tentative LNCS, EI Index). [Here](https://link.springer.com/conference/flare) is an example of our previous FLARE Challenge. The challenge summary paper will be submitted to top-tired journals. Here are some of our previous summaries: * "Fast and low-GPU-memory abdomen CT organ segmentation: the flare challenge." Medical Image Analysis 82 (2022): 102616. * "Unleashing the strengths of unlabeled data in pan-cancer abdominal organ quantification: the flare22 challenge." Lancet Digital Health (2024). * "The multimodality cell segmentation challenge: toward universal solutions." Nature Methods (2024): 21, 1103–1113.
pages.content_zh:
## <center>[MICCAI FLARE26](https://flare-medfm.github.io/) 任务2: AutoMSC: 自动医学图像分割和分类</center>

用于3D医学成像的深度学习模型传统上是为单个任务(分割或分类)手工设计的，需要对架构、超参数和预处理管道进行大量手动调整。随着临床数据集规模和复杂性的增加，这种手动设计过程变得越来越低效，限制了自适应通用模型的部署。受医学分割十项全能挑战赛和获胜方案nnU-Net成功的启发，任务2侧重于构建能够自动适应多样化3D医学成像数据集，同时执行分割和分类的自配置模型。

本任务旨在推进3D医学成像自主模型设计系统的下一代发展。参赛者需要设计能够自动推断最优配置(如架构、分辨率、补丁大小、归一化策略和损失平衡)的模型，并联合学习高质量分割掩码和临床有意义的分类标签。这些模型应能跨成像模态、肿瘤类型进行泛化，无需特定任务的手动工程，包括MRI扫描中的前列腺癌复发预测、CT扫描中的肺结节诊断和PET/CT扫描中的肝转移灶来源预测。

主要特征：

- **多任务学习**：模型必须从同一输入体积执行3D分割和分类，同时优化两个输出的精度并保持计算效率。
- **自配置**：解决方案应包含自动配置机制，能够适应数据集属性，如体素间距、图像大小、对比度变异性和类不平衡，无需人工设计的启发式方法。
- **数据集多样性**：基准包括具有不同模态(CT、MRI和PET-CT)和分类目标的异构3D医学成像扫描，促进真正可泛化3D模型的开发。
- **鲁棒性和效率**：模型将基于分割精度(DSC和NSD)、分类性能(平衡精度和AUROC)和资源效率(运行时间)进行评估，突出其在实际临床应用中的潜力。

参赛者还被鼓励探索其他挑战赛道，网址为https://flare-medfm.github.io/，包括：泛癌症分割和多模态模型。

---

## 🚀 加入挑战赛(2026.04.01开放)

* 在本网站注册账户并加入挑战赛
* 填写[注册表](https://forms.gle/my1MimQ758oDyhWb9)   注：若需修改团队信息，请重新提交表格。
* 申请数据集[FLARE-AutoMSC](https://huggingface.co/datasets/FLARE-MedFM/FLARE-AutoMSC)。我们将在审核申请后1-2个工作日内批准您的申请。

pages.title: Dataset
pages.content:
## Datasets

### Dataset 001 — BrainMets (PROTEAS)
A **longitudinal multi-modal brain metastasis** dataset with 6 co-registered channels (T1, T1c, T2, FLAIR, CT, RTP). Provides **3-class tumor segmentation** (necrotic core, enhancing tumor, edema) and **NSCLC vs. Breast Carcinoma** primary-origin classification. 166 timepoints across 40 patients. Licence: CC BY 4.0.
**Source:** Flouri D, Papanikas CP, Manikis GC, et al. *A longitudinal MRI dataset of brain metastases with tumor segmentations, clinical & radiomic data.* **Scientific Data**, 19 Nov 2025; 12:1828.

### Dataset 002 — MU_Glioma_Post
**Post-treatment glioma** multi-sequence MRI (t1c, t1n, t2f, t2w) with **4-class tumor segmentation** (NCR, ED, ET, NET_RC) and a **3-class primary diagnosis** label (GBM / Astrocytoma / Other). 591 timepoints from 203 patients (longitudinal).
**Source:** Mahmoud E, Gass J, Dhemesh Y, et al. *MU-Glioma Post: A comprehensive dataset of automated MR multi-sequence segmentation and clinical features.* **Scientific Data**, 20 Nov 2025; 12(1):1847.

### Dataset 003 — UCSD_PTGB
The **UCSD post-treatment glioblastoma** cohort imaged with T1post, FLAIR, and ADC. Provides **total cellular tumor** masks and **IDH mutation status** (wild-type vs. mutant). 184 cases, 3 channels.
**Source:** Gagnon L, Gupta D, Nguyen U, et al. *The University of California San Diego Post-Treatment Glioblastoma (UCSD-PTGBM) annotated multimodal MRI Dataset.* **Scientific Data**, 6 Jan 2026.

### Dataset 004 — PI-CAI
The largest dataset in the benchmark: **prostate MRI** (T2W, ADC, HBV) for **clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) segmentation** and **6-class ISUP grade** classification (Benign/Indolent + ISUP 1–5). 1,500 cases from 1,476 patients across 11 sites.
**Source:** Saha A, Bosma JS, Twilt JJ, et al. *Artificial intelligence and radiologists in prostate cancer detection on MRI (PI-CAI): an international, paired, non-inferiority, confirmatory study.* **Lancet Oncology**, 2024; 25:879–887.

### Dataset 005 — LUNA25
Cropped **low-dose chest CT patches** from the **LUNA25 challenge** for lung cancer screening. Each patch contains a nodule with a **segmentation mask** and a **benign vs. malignant** risk label. 6,141 nodule crops, single CT channel. Licence: CC BY 4.0.
**Source:** Peeters D, Obreja B, Antonissen N, Jacobs C. *Benchmarking of Artificial Intelligence and Radiologists for Lung Cancer Screening in CT: The LUNA25 Challenge.* **MICCAI 2025** (Zenodo: [10.5281/zenodo.15094631](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15094631)).

### Dataset 061 — PETWB_Lung
A subset of the **PETWB-REP** whole-body FDG PET/CT collection, paired with TotalSegmentator-derived **lung masks** and a **lung-cancer vs. other** label. 490 cases drawn from 4 cohorts, 2 channels (CT, PET). Tasks: binary lung segmentation + binary cancer-type classification. Licence: CC BY 4.0.
**Source:** Xue L, Feng G, Wenbo Z, et al. *PETWB-REP: A Multi-Cancer Whole-Body FDG PET/CT Dataset with Corresponding Radiology Reports.* **Scientific Data**, 2026.

### Dataset 062 — PETWB_Liver
Companion to Dataset 061 from the **same PETWB-REP source**, but targeting the **liver**: TotalSegmentator-derived liver masks paired with a **liver-cancer vs. other** label. 490 cases, 2 channels (CT, PET). Licence: CC BY 4.0.
**Source:** Xue L, Feng G, Wenbo Z, et al. *PETWB-REP: A Multi-Cancer Whole-Body FDG PET/CT Dataset with Corresponding Radiology Reports.* **Scientific Data**, 2026.
pages.content_zh:
## 数据集

### 数据集 001 — BrainMets (PROTEAS)
**纵向多模态脑转移瘤**数据集，包含6个共配准通道（T1、T1c、T2、FLAIR、CT、RTP）。提供**3类肿瘤分割**（坏死核心、增强肿瘤、水肿）和**非小细胞肺癌 vs. 乳腺癌**原发灶分类。40名患者共166个时间点。许可证：CC BY 4.0。
**来源：** Flouri D, Papanikas CP, Manikis GC, 等。*A longitudinal MRI dataset of brain metastases with tumor segmentations, clinical & radiomic data.* **Scientific Data**, 2025年11月19日; 12:1828。

### 数据集 002 — MU_Glioma_Post
**治疗后胶质瘤**多序列MRI（t1c、t1n、t2f、t2w），包含**4类肿瘤分割**（NCR、ED、ET、NET_RC）和**3类原发诊断**标签（胶质母细胞瘤/星形细胞瘤/其他）。来自203名患者的591个纵向时间点。
**来源：** Mahmoud E, Gass J, Dhemesh Y, 等。*MU-Glioma Post: A comprehensive dataset of automated MR multi-sequence segmentation and clinical features.* **Scientific Data**, 2025年11月20日; 12(1):1847。

### 数据集 003 — UCSD_PTGB
**加州大学圣地亚哥分校治疗后胶质母细胞瘤**队列，采用T1post、FLAIR和ADC成像。提供**全细胞肿瘤**掩模和**IDH突变状态**（野生型 vs. 突变型）。184个病例，3个通道。
**来源：** Gagnon L, Gupta D, Nguyen U, 等。*The University of California San Diego Post-Treatment Glioblastoma (UCSD-PTGBM) annotated multimodal MRI Dataset.* **Scientific Data**, 2026年1月6日。

### 数据集 004 — PI-CAI
基准中最大的数据集：**前列腺MRI**（T2W、ADC、HBV），用于**临床显著性前列腺癌（csPCa）分割**和**6级ISUP分级**分类（良性/惰性 + ISUP 1–5）。来自11个中心的1,476名患者的1,500个病例。
**来源：** Saha A, Bosma JS, Twilt JJ, 等。*Artificial intelligence and radiologists in prostate cancer detection on MRI (PI-CAI): an international, paired, non-inferiority, confirmatory study.* **Lancet Oncology**, 2024; 25:879–887。

### 数据集 005 — LUNA25
来自**LUNA25挑战赛**的裁剪**低剂量胸部CT图像块**，用于肺癌筛查。每个图像块包含一个结节及**分割掩模**和**良性 vs. 恶性**风险标签。6,141个结节裁剪图，单CT通道。许可证：CC BY 4.0。
**来源：** Peeters D, Obreja B, Antonissen N, Jacobs C。*Benchmarking of Artificial Intelligence and Radiologists for Lung Cancer Screening in CT: The LUNA25 Challenge.* **MICCAI 2025**（Zenodo: [10.5281/zenodo.15094631](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15094631)）。

### 数据集 061 — PETWB_Lung
**PETWB-REP**全身FDG PET/CT集合的子集，配对TotalSegmentator衍生的**肺掩模**和**肺癌 vs. 其他**标签。来自4个队列的490个病例，2个通道（CT、PET）。任务：二元肺分割 + 二元癌症类型分类。许可证：CC BY 4.0。
**来源：** Xue L, Feng G, Wenbo Z, 等。*PETWB-REP: A Multi-Cancer Whole-Body FDG PET/CT Dataset with Corresponding Radiology Reports.* **Scientific Data**, 2026。

### 数据集 062 — PETWB_Liver
来自**同一PETWB-REP来源**的数据集061的配套数据集，针对**肝脏**：TotalSegmentator衍生的肝脏掩模配对**肝癌 vs. 其他**标签。490个病例，2个通道（CT、PET）。许可证：CC BY 4.0。
**来源：** Xue L, Feng G, Wenbo Z, 等。*PETWB-REP: A Multi-Cancer Whole-Body FDG PET/CT Dataset with Corresponding Radiology Reports.* **Scientific Data**, 2026。

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content: ## Evaluation **Segmentation accuracy metrics:** * Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) * Normalized Surface Distance (NSD) **Binary classification accuracy metrics:** * Balanced Accuracy * Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUROC) **Accuracy Evaluation Scripts:** * https://github.com/medfm-flare/AutoMSC_Baseline **Segmentation efficiency metrics:** * Running time (s). We give running time a tolerance of 45s (including the docker starting time). Moreover, the inference time for each case should be within 60s. Otherwise, the corresponding case will be regarded as a failed case (DSC=0, NSD=0). ![running time](https://s2.loli.net/2024/04/06/Fvt1nmPYqZLWxsU.jpg) * GPU memory consumption (area under GPU memory-time curve). ![gpu memory](https://s2.loli.net/2024/03/14/XlnhM3qB27yVZtS.png) All metrics will be used to compute the ranking. We give GPU memory consumption a 4GB tolerance, GPU Memory = max(0, Real GPU Memory-4096MB) because all the previous top teams (i.e., FLARE21-23) can achieve state-of-the-art segmentation accuracy within this tolerance. We also give running time a tolerance (the running time of the winning solution in FLARE 2023) because it satisfies the typical clinical requirements and the code has been publicly available. Evaluation code has been publicly available at: https://github.com/JunMa11/FLARE docker load -i teamname.tar.gz docker container run --gpus "device=1" -m 28G --name teamname --rm -v \$PWD/FLARE_Test/:/workspace/inputs/ -v \$PWD/teamname_outputs/:/workspace/outputs/ teamname:latest /bin/bash -c "sh predict.sh" --- ## Evaluation Platform The submitted docker containers will be evaluated on a Ubuntu 20.04 desktop. Detailed information is listed as follows: * CPU: Intel® Xeon(R) W-2133 CPU @ 3.60GHz × 12 * GPU: NVIDIA QUADRO RTX5000 (16G) * RAM: 28G * CUDA Version: 13.0 * Docker version 29.4.2 --- ## Ranking Scheme Following the recommendation in ChallengeR [1], we eomply a rank-then-aggregate ranking scheme with the following three steps: Step 1. For each testing case, we compute the four metrics; Step 2. Rank participants for each of the N testing cases and each metric; Step 3. Average all these rankings. [1] Wiesenfarth, M., Reinke, A., Landman, B.A. et al. Methods and open-source toolkit for analyzing and visualizing challenge results. Sci Rep 11, 2369 (2021).
pages.content_zh: ## 评估 **分割精度指标：** * 骰子相似系数（DSC） * 归一化表面距离（NSD） **二分类精度指标：** * 平衡精度 * 受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC） **精度评估脚本：** * https://github.com/medfm-flare/AutoMSC_Baseline **分割效率指标：** * 运行时间（秒）。我们对运行时间给予45秒的容差（包括docker启动时间）。此外，每个病例的推理时间应在60秒以内。否则，该病例将被视为失败病例（DSC=0，NSD=0）。 ![运行时间](https://s2.loli.net/2024/04/06/Fvt1nmPYqZLWxsU.jpg) * GPU内存消耗（GPU内存-时间曲线下的面积）。 ![GPU内存](https://s2.loli.net/2024/03/14/XlnhM3qB27yVZtS.png) 所有指标都将用于计算排名。我们对GPU内存消耗给予4GB的容差，GPU内存 = max(0, 实际GPU内存-4096MB)，因为所有前期顶级团队（即FLARE21-23）都能在该容差范围内实现最先进的分割精度。我们还对运行时间给予容差（FLARE 2023中获胜方案的运行时间），因为它满足典型的临床要求且代码已公开发布。 评估代码已公开发布于：https://github.com/JunMa11/FLARE docker load -i teamname.tar.gz docker container run --gpus "device=1" -m 28G --name teamname --rm -v \$PWD/FLARE_Test/:/workspace/inputs/ -v \$PWD/teamname_outputs/:/workspace/outputs/ teamname:latest /bin/bash -c "sh predict.sh" --- ## 评估平台 提交的docker容器将在Ubuntu 20.04桌面上进行评估。详细信息如下： * CPU：Intel® Xeon(R) W-2133 CPU @ 3.60GHz × 12 * GPU：NVIDIA QUADRO RTX5000（16G） * RAM：28G * CUDA版本：13.0 * Docker版本29.4.2 --- ## 排名方案 根据ChallengeR [1]中的建议，我们采用先排名后聚合的排名方案，包含以下三个步骤： 步骤1. 对于每个测试病例，计算四项指标； 步骤2. 对每个测试病例和每项指标对参赛者进行排名； 步骤3. 对所有排名进行平均。 [1] Wiesenfarth, M., Reinke, A., Landman, B.A. et al. Methods and open-source toolkit for analyzing and visualizing challenge results. Sci Rep 11, 2369 (2021).

pages.title: Q&A
pages.content:
## Common Questions

Please send emails to chingyuanyu.iec@gmail.com if you have any other questions. 

**Q:  How long can the participation request be approved after sending the signed challenge rule?**

A:  The request will be approved within 2-4 working days if the signed challenge rule document is filled out correctly.

**Q: I'm only interested in the challenge dataset but I do not want to join the challenge. Can I download the dataset without joining the challenge?**

A: Thanks for your interest. To ensure enough submissions, the dataset is only available to participants during the challenge. 

**Q: How many people can form a team？**

A: Each team can have at most 6 people. The authors in your paper should be the same as the team member list.

**Q: I have joined the challenge and downloaded the dataset. Can I quit the challenge?**

A: No! Please respect the signed agreement. If registered participants do not make successful submissions, all the team members will be listed in the dishonest list.

Algorithm-related issues

**Q: Can we use other datasets or pre-trained models to develop the segmentation algorithms?**

A: Yes, but you need to post them in the forum first. 

**Q: Can we manually annotate the unlabeled images to enlarge the training set?**

A: No. Any manual interventions are not allowed. 

**Q: Can we manually select the high-quality pseudo labels for the unlabeled images?**

A: No. Any manual interventions are not allowed. 

**Q: Does the validation submission affects the final ranking?**

A: No.

**Q: During the testing phase, can I modify the methods and the paper?**

A: Yes, you can make modifications before the testing submission. After making the testing submission, you cannot make modifications.


**Q: Can I use validation set for model pre-training?**
A: No!

**Q: Can I use other public datasets for model pre-training?** 
A: Yes, but you should post the dataset link on forum and also need to submit an algorithm that is trained only with the challenge dataset. 

**Q: When can I access the testing set?**
A: The testing set will not be released during the challenge to avoid data leakage.
pages.content_zh:
## 常见问题

如有其他问题，请发送邮件至 chingyuanyu.iec@gmail.com。

**Q: 发送签署的挑战规则后，参赛申请需要多长时间才能被批准？**

A: 如果签署的挑战规则文件填写正确，申请将在2-4个工作日内被批准。

**Q: 我只对挑战数据集感兴趣，但不想参加挑战。我可以不加入挑战而下载数据集吗？**

A: 感谢您的关注。为了确保有足够的提交，数据集仅在挑战期间对参与者开放。

**Q: 一个团队最多可以有多少人？**

A: 每支队伍最多可以有6人。论文作者应与团队成员名单相同。

**Q: 我已加入挑战并下载了数据集。我可以退出挑战吗？**

A: 不可以！请尊重已签署的协议。如果已注册的参与者没有成功提交作品，所有团队成员将被列入不诚实名单。

**算法相关问题**

**Q: 我们可以使用其他数据集或预训练模型来开发分割算法吗？**

A: 可以，但你需要先在论坛上发布它们。

**Q: 我们可以手动标注未标记的图像来扩大训练集吗？**

A: 不可以。不允许任何手动干预。

**Q: 我们可以手动选择未标记图像的高质量伪标签吗？**

A: 不可以。不允许任何手动干预。

**Q: 验证提交会影响最终排名吗？**

A: 不会。

**Q: 在测试阶段，我可以修改方法和论文吗？**

A: 可以，你可以在测试提交前进行修改。进行测试提交后，你不能进行修改。

**Q: 我可以将验证集用于模型预训练吗？**

A: 不可以！

**Q: 我可以使用其他公开数据集进行模型预训练吗？**

A: 可以，但你应该在论坛上发布数据集链接，同时还需要提交一个仅用挑战数据集训练的算法。

**Q: 我何时可以访问测试集？**

A: 测试集在挑战期间不会发布，以避免数据泄露。

12418.title: PBVS 2026 - Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution (HISR) challenge
12418.description:
This challenge benchmarks ×4 super-resolution for close-range SWIR hyperspectral imaging.
Participants receive low-resolution HSI cubes acquired using the same sensor with different lenses to create controlled resolution variation without spectral bias. The task is to reconstruct a high-resolution SWIR hyperspectral image from a ×4 downsampled input.
12418.description_zh:

pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
# PBVS @ CVPR 2026 - Hyperspectral Images Super-Resolution (HISR) challenge

## Overview

Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution (HISR) goes beyond conventional SR: hyperspectral data contain rich wavelength-dependent information, where each band encodes material-specific spectral signatures. This means HISR must simultaneously preserve spatial detail and spectral integrity, ensuring reconstructed images remain physically meaningful rather than visually plausible only.

HSI data are also large and acquisition-intensive, making full-resolution capture costly and slow. Super-resolution therefore offers a powerful and practical pathway to reduce acquisition burden while enabling high-quality analysis.

This challenge introduces the **first** hyperspectral super-resolution benchmark within the PBVS CVPR 2026 workshop. It focuses on real LR-HR pairs, at ×4 SR under controlled lab conditions, using data collected with the same sensor and different optics to isolate spatial scaling while maintaining spectral consistency. 

**The challenge is to reconstruct ×4 real super-resolution hyperspectral images from the provided low-resolution hyperspectral patches image.**

Each low-resolution cube has a perfectly aligned high-resolution counterpart that serves as ground truth, enabling precise evaluation of both spatial recovery and spectral fidelity.
Participants develop methods that upscale the LR data by x4 while preserving spectral consistency across all wavelengths.


## Important dates

- 2026.01.12 Release of train and validation dataset (input and output)
- **2026.01.15 Test data release (inputs only)**
- 2026.01.15 Testing phase server online

- **2026.03.01 Test output results submission deadline**
- 2026.03.03 Contribution from participants (top results should provide a brief description of the proposed solution together with an illustration of the architecture; code also should be shared)
- **2026.03.06 Paper submission deadline for entries from the challenge**
- 2026.06.03 PBVS workshop and challenges, results and award ceremony (CVPR 2026)
pages.content_zh:
# PBVS @ CVPR 2026 - 高光谱图像超分辨率（HISR）挑战赛

## 概述

高光谱图像超分辨率（HISR）超越了传统超分辨率的范畴：高光谱数据包含丰富的波长相关信息，每个波段都编码了特定材料的光谱特征。这意味着HISR必须同时保持空间细节和光谱完整性，确保重建的图像在物理意义上是真实的，而不仅仅是视觉上可信的。

高光谱数据体积大且获取密集，使得全分辨率捕获成本高且速度慢。因此，超分辨率提供了一条强大而实用的途径来减少获取负担，同时实现高质量分析。

本挑战赛在PBVS CVPR 2026研讨会内推出**首个**高光谱超分辨率基准数据集。它专注于实际的低分辨率-高分辨率对偶，在×4超分辨率的受控实验室条件下，使用同一传感器和不同光学器件采集的数据，以隔离空间缩放同时保持光谱一致性。

**本挑战赛的目标是从提供的低分辨率高光谱图像块重建×4实超分辨率高光谱图像。**

每个低分辨率立方体都有一个完美对齐的高分辨率对应体作为真实值，能够精确评估空间恢复和光谱保真度。参与者需要开发能够将低分辨率数据上采样×4倍的方法，同时保持所有波长的光谱一致性。

## 重要日期

- 2026.01.12 发布训练和验证数据集（输入和输出）
- **2026.01.15 测试数据发布（仅输入）**
- 2026.01.15 测试阶段服务器上线

- **2026.03.01 测试输出结果提交截止日期**
- 2026.03.03 参赛者贡献作品（排名靠前的成果应提供简要的解决方案描述和架构图示；还应共享代码）
- **2026.03.06 挑战赛参赛作品论文提交截止日期**
- 2026.06.03 PBVS研讨会和挑战赛、结果发布及颁奖典礼（CVPR 2026）

pages.title: Dataset
pages.content:
# Dataset

## Description
The dataset used in this challenge is **Version 2 of the HSI Lens Dataset**, introduced in the PBVS CVPR 2025 paper:  
[Ulrichsen et al., *“A True Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution Dataset”](
https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2025W/PBVS/html/Ulrichsen_A_True_Hyperspectral_Image_Super-Resolution_Dataset_CVPRW_2025_paper.html)

This dataset provides **perfectly aligned low- and high-resolution SWIR hyperspectral image pairs**, acquired using a single Specim FX17 line-scanning camera (900–1700 nm). Spatial resolution differences were generated purely through **lens swapping**, ensuring identical spectral content while isolating spatial resolution as the primary challenge.

- High-resolution images: **3172 × 640 px**, captured with a 12° lens  
- Low-resolution images: **793 × 160 px**, captured with a 38° lens  
- Focus ensured using automated focus metrics and verified with sub-pixel registration  

Scenes cover **spectrally rich and diverse SWIR materials**, including plastics, wood, electronics, metals, fabrics, corrosion, printed text, painted surfaces, and various industrial objects.

## Splits
The dataset includes **70 registered image pairs**, divided as follows:
- **55** pairs for training  
- **10** pairs for validation  
- **5** pairs reserved for testing (not released)

Participants receive LR–HR pairs for training and validation.  
For the **test set**, only LR inputs are provided; high-resolution ground truth remains withheld for fair evaluation.
The LR version of the test set patches can be downloaded here: https://filesender.belnet.be/?s=download&token=237989c4-8c1a-4bd8-b652-49e5dbd90778

## Availability
The dataset can be downloaded from the repository “Files” section or via:  
**Zenodo DOI:** https://zenodo.org/records/18171738

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
# Evaluation Metrics

Submissions are evaluated using **Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR)** and **Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM)**, computed on 20 random patches with a size of **200x200x224 (w x h x bands)** of the hidden hyperspectral test set. Rankings are based on the combined performance across these metrics.

The LR patches of the test dataset can be downloaded here: https://filesender.belnet.be/?s=download&token=237989c4-8c1a-4bd8-b652-49e5dbd90778

Both metrics are computed **per band and averaged** over the hyperspectral cube. 

## Evaluation Dataset
Evaluation is performed only on a fixed set of patches, not on the full images.

* **5 test scenes** are selected.
* From each scene, **6 patches are extracted.**
* Each patch has dimensions** 200 × 200 × 224** (height × width × spectral bands).

This results in a total of 30 evaluation patches (5 scenes × 6 patches).
**All metrics are computed exclusively on these 30 patches.**
Full-resolution test images are not used for evaluation.

## Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR)
PSNR measures the pixel-wise reconstruction fidelity between the super-resolved output and the high-resolution ground truth.  
Higher PSNR values indicate more accurate spatial reconstruction.


## Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM)
SAM quantifies the **spectral similarity** between reconstructed and ground-truth spectra at each pixel by measuring the angle between their spectral vectors.  
Lower SAM values indicate better preservation of material-relevant spectral signatures and higher physical plausibility.

Only low-resolution inputs are provided for the test phase; corresponding HR ground truth remains hidden and is used exclusively for evaluation.

## Reproducibility and code availability (mandatory)

To ensure transparency, fairness, and reproducibility, all participating teams are required to make their full source code publicly available, preferably via a GitHub repository.

The released code must include all components necessary to reproduce the reported results, including:
- Training and evaluation scripts
- Model architectures and configuration files
- Dataset loading and preprocessing steps
- Environment specifications (e.g., requirements.txt, environment.yml, or Docker files)
- Clear, step-by-step instructions to run the code end to end

**The challenge organizers will independently train and evaluate all submitted methods from scratch to verify the reported results.
This verification process will directly affect the final ranking.**

**Teams that fail to provide their source code**, or that do not include sufficient information to reproduce their results, **will be disqualified** from the challenge.
pages.content_zh:
# 评估指标

提交的结果使用**峰值信噪比（PSNR）**和**光谱角制图仪（SAM）**进行评估，这些指标在隐藏高光谱测试集的20个随机补丁上计算，每个补丁大小为**200×200×224（宽×高×波段）**。排名基于这些指标的综合性能。

测试数据集的低分辨率补丁可在此处下载：https://filesender.belnet.be/?s=download&token=237989c4-8c1a-4bd8-b652-49e5dbd90778

两个指标都是**按波段计算，然后在整个高光谱立方体上求平均**。

## 评估数据集
评估仅在固定的补丁集合上进行，不在完整图像上进行。

* **选择5个测试场景**
* 从每个场景中**提取6个补丁**
* 每个补丁的尺寸为**200×200×224**（高×宽×光谱波段）

总共产生30个评估补丁（5个场景×6个补丁）。
**所有指标的计算仅限于这30个补丁。**
完整分辨率的测试图像不用于评估。

## 峰值信噪比（PSNR）
PSNR衡量超分辨率输出与高分辨率真值之间的像素级重建保真度。
较高的PSNR值表示更精确的空间重建。

## 光谱角制图仪（SAM）
SAM通过测量每个像素处重建光谱与真值光谱的光谱向量之间的夹角，量化**光谱相似度**。
较低的SAM值表示材料相关光谱特征保留更好，物理可信度更高。

测试阶段仅提供低分辨率输入；相应的高分辨率真值保持隐藏，仅用于评估。

## 可重现性和代码可用性（强制性）

为确保透明度、公平性和可重现性，所有参赛团队都必须公开发布完整源代码，最好通过GitHub存储库。

发布的代码必须包含所有必要的组件以重现报告的结果，包括：
- 训练和评估脚本
- 模型架构和配置文件
- 数据集加载和预处理步骤
- 环境规范（例如requirements.txt、environment.yml或Docker文件）
- 清晰的逐步说明以端到端运行代码

**挑战赛组织者将从头独立训练和评估所有提交的方法，以验证报告的结果。
此验证过程将直接影响最终排名。**

**未能提供源代码的团队**，或未包含足够信息以重现其结果的团队，**将被取消参赛资格**。

pages.content:
# Submission format

Participants must submit their predictions according to the instructions provided below. **Failure to comply with these rules may result in disqualification or incorrect scoring.**

## Packaging
- The submission must be uploaded as a single ZIP file.
- The ZIP file must contain the corresponding scale folder (x4) with the generated SR images.

```
submission.zip/
├── x4/
│   ├── HR_00.h5
│   ├── HR_01.h5
│   ├── HR_02.h5
│   ├──  ...
```
Make sure there is only one key in the .h5 file, it does not matter what the name of that key is.
The dataset must be a 3D array shaped like: (H, W, C) where C = #spectral bands

## Results

- Once uploaded, refresh the page to update the submission status.
- Scoring could take up to 5 minutes.
- For debugging, click on the submission, navigate to Logs tab, and view Scoring Logs > stdout

pages.title: Publication
pages.content:
# Publication
Participants are invited to submit full research papers detailing the methodologies, findings, and contributions developed within the scope of this challenge. Accepted manuscripts will be published in the official proceedings of the CVPR 2026 Workshop.

### Submission Guidelines
Should participants choose to submit a paper, the following protocols must be observed:
* Submission System: All manuscripts must be submitted electronically via the workshop’s OpenReview system (platform subject to confirmation).
* Formatting: Submissions must strictly adhere to the CVPR Author Guidelines, adopting the mandated structure and formatting requirements.
* Page Limits: Papers are limited to eight pages, including all figures and tables. Additional pages containing only cited references are permitted.
* Review Process: All submissions will undergo a double-blind peer review process.
* Important Date: The deadline for paper submission is first week of March (check main page).

### Challenge Report Co-authorship
For each individual evaluation metric, the top-ranked team will be invited to serve as co-authors on the PBVS HISR challenge report. Furthermore, the results and methodologies of the top three teams per metric will be acknowledged and discussed in the final published paper. Winning teams will be contacted directly with further instructions.

**Note:** Top teams should provide a brief description of their proposed solution along with an illustration of the architecture. This information may be included in a potential publication if the submission is accepted. Additionally, the code should be uploaded in github and shared according to the Terms and Conditions.

pages.title: Evaluation & Submission
pages.content:
# Evaluation & Submission

This page covers how to format a submission and how entries are scored. For the
task, dataset and timeline, see the Overview tab.

## Building predictions

Produce one detection file per evaluation frame, named after that frame's id.
The frame ids you must predict are listed in the starting kit
(`validation_frames.txt` for Development, `test_frames.txt` for Final). Each
line is one detection with nine fields:

```
# cls cx cy cz dx dy dz yaw score
1 12.34 -3.21 0.05 4.10 1.92 1.55 1.5708 0.97
```

* `cls` ∈ {1=Vehicle, 2=Bike, 3=Pedestrian}
* `cx cy cz`: box centre in metres, "top" ego frame
* `dx dy dz`: length, width, height in metres
* `yaw`: heading (rotation about +z) in radians
* `score`: confidence in [0, 1] (used for ranking detections)

Zip the per-frame files at the root of the archive and upload on the Submit tab.
The starting kit's `SUBMISSION_FORMAT.md` is the authoritative spec, with a
sample submission and a format-checker. Run the checker before you upload.

## Evaluation

We follow the official Mixed Signals / OpenCOOD evaluation protocol exactly,
so leaderboard numbers are directly comparable to the dataset paper.

### Metric

* Matching: Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) rotated-box IoU between predicted and
  ground-truth boxes (the z/height dimension is not used for matching, in line
  with the dataset benchmark).
* Average Precision (AP): VOC-2010 "all-points" interpolation, the area
  under the precision-recall curve (not the 11-point variant).
* Per class: AP is computed independently for vehicle, bike and
  pedestrian at IoU thresholds 0.3, 0.5 and 0.7.
* Matching rule: within each frame, detections are ranked by descending
  confidence and greedily matched to ground-truth boxes. Each ground-truth box
  can be matched at most once. Unmatched detections (or matches below the IoU
  threshold) are false positives.
* Evaluation range: boxes whose centre falls outside `x, y ∈ [-51.2, 51.2] m`
  are excluded from both predictions and ground truth before scoring.

### Ranking by mAP

The leaderboard is ranked by the headline mAP, the mean of the three per-class
operating points reported in the paper:

```
mAP = mean( Vehicle AP@0.5 , Bike AP@0.5 , Pedestrian AP@0.3 )
```

(Pedestrians are scored at the looser 0.3 IoU because the boxes are small.) The
leaderboard also reports Vehicle and Bike AP at IoU 0.5/0.7 and Pedestrian AP at
IoU 0.3/0.5, matching the published tables, but only mAP decides the ranking.
Ties on mAP are broken by the leaderboard columns left to right (starting with
Vehicle AP@0.5), then by submission time, so earlier submissions rank higher.

### Scoring program

The scoring program is open and downloadable from the Submit / Files
area. It depends only on `numpy` and implements the BEV IoU and VOC AP from
scratch, so you can run it locally against your own validation labels to
reproduce leaderboard scores exactly.
